description:
Retype the issue-id parameters of the storage trait, its backends and the repository index.

## Background

`IssueStore` methods `load_issue` (`crates/jit/src/storage/mod.rs:155`), `load_issue_or_not_found` (`:176`) and `list_gate_runs_for_issue` (`:269`) take raw ids. Implementors are `InMemoryStorage` (`storage/memory.rs:820`) and `JsonFileStorage` (`storage/json.rs:1045`), plus the test wrappers `PublicationProbeStore` (`crates/jit/tests/fast_docs_templates/template_apply_atomicity_tests.rs:125`) and `FailingMutationStorage` (`crates/jit/tests/fast_rules/local_rule_enforcement_tests.rs:840`). `RepositoryIndex.all_ids` and `deleted_ids` are `Vec<String>` (`repository_state/index.rs:13-15`), with `storage/json.rs` the heaviest consumer. `storage/warnings.rs` carries ids in three fields, `storage/artifact_planning.rs:32` takes `container_id: &str`, and `storage/repository_state_store_tests.rs` is the shared store test module.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `load_issue`, `load_issue_or_not_found` and `list_gate_runs_for_issue` take `&IssueId`, and both backends and both test wrappers implement the retyped trait; the rest of the wrappers' test files belongs to their suites.
- [hard] REQ-02: `RepositoryIndex` holds `all_ids` and `deleted_ids` as `Vec<IssueId>`, and the stored index is byte-identical.
- [hard] REQ-03: No struct field or function parameter under `crates/jit/src/storage/`, lease records excepted, holds an issue id as `String`, `&str` or `Vec<String>`.
- [hard] REQ-04: The shared storage conformance suite passes against both backends.
- [hard] REQ-05: Code in this family, its unit-test modules included, uses issue ids only through `as_str()`, `short_id()`, `Display`, `Debug`, `Clone`, `PartialEq`/`Eq`, `PartialOrd`/`Ord`, `Hash` and serde, so it compiles unchanged once `IssueId` is the validated newtype.

## Notes

`crate::domain::identity::IssueId` is at this point an alias for `String`, and the `IssueIdStaging` trait gives it `short_id()`. Retyping to the alias is compiler-neutral, so this change is checked by its criteria rather than by type errors; a later change replaces the alias with the validated newtype and the compiler then reports any site missed here. Parameters are retyped outside-in: the CLI and server entry points already resolve ids, and callers in this family are retyped before the functions they call in inner layers.
title: Storage trait and backends take issue ids as IssueId
